task.title: Add an Organization Administrator to a group
task.shortdesc: You can include an Organization Administrator user in a group if you want an Organization Administrator to have the roles assigned to that group. An Organization Administrator does not inherit all available roles for all Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console applications.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.
Create a group if one does not exist. For more information, see .
For information about how to configure notifications for behavior groups, see .

prereq.note: This procedure assumes that you want to modify an existing group and add an Organization Administrator to the group. Alternatively, you can add an Organization Administrator to a group when you create a new group.
Any roles not inherited by means of the Default access group or the Default admin access group must be assigned through group membership.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > GroupsRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Groups. The Groups page displays.
Click the group Name to display details about the group.
On the group details page, click the Members tab to display a list of authorized users who are a member of the group.
On the Add members to the group page that appears, find the Organization Administrator user name and click the check box next to the name.

info.p: For example, if the Organization Administrator user name is smith-jones, find that name and click the check box next to smith-jones. You can add additional names.

step.cmd: Verify the name list is complete and click the Add to group action.
step.stepresult: Notification pop-ups appear when the action successfully completes.
